defect.statement: pdf-lib's PDFDocument.create() writes the wall clock into /CreationDate and /ModDate. save({ updateMetadata: false }) only declines to REFRESH that stamp on save; it does not remove the stamp already there. A builder that creates an assembled packet, never pins its dates, and saves that way emits different bytes on every run.
defect.whyItMatters: RASTER_QUEUE.json pins canonicalPdfSha256 and boundaryPdfSha256. A family whose packet bytes move on every rebuild holds a raster receipt bound to bytes nobody can reproduce, so the visual gate's evidence stops being regenerable and the queue's carry-forward discards a verdict that nothing actually invalidated.
